use_cases: Hero landing page sections with immersive scroll-driven storytelling
Product or feature showcases with parallax image scaling effects
Team and company about sections with scroll-synced imagery
Portfolio or media content sections with sticky image reveals
Narrative-driven content pages where images and text animate together
ai_summary: A parallax scrolling content component that creates immersive visual storytelling through scroll-linked animations using Framer Motion. Features sticky images that scale down and fade while users scroll, with text overlays that animate in sync. The component is built as a composite of multiple parts (TextParallaxContent, StickyImage, OverlayCopy) creating a modular system suitable for landing pages, portfolios, and content-heavy websites that need engaging scroll-based visual effects.
